comment:
A second output, Envelope, is configured at Sub.cpp:106 and written every sample at Sub.cpp:269 with ten times the amplitude envelope, but the widget adds no jack for it (Sub.cpp:296 lists the only output), so it cannot be patched or clicked. The manual lists only a mono audio output, correctly.

Every figure the manual gives checks out: nine octave positions from -4 to +4 (Sub.cpp:83), -100 to +100 cents of Tune on the upper layer alone (Sub.cpp:90, 149-152), and Drive as compensated asymmetric saturation rather than a volume control (Sub.cpp:229-239).

The six CV inputs are read without isConnected, which is harmless because an unpatched input reads 0V. Accent is the exception and is checked (Sub.cpp:138).

Below about 30Hz the sub layer's fundamental is progressively weakened, down to about a third, while its second and third harmonics are kept, so a very low note still carries pitch without the speaker excursion (Sub.cpp:256-259).
